mid_task_correction.what_happened: The initial pass of this inventory checked only git-committed content in the isolated worktree (git worktree add carries over committed files only, never gitignored/untracked ones) and concluded no raw per-candidate data was 'present locally' -- true for the isolated worktree at that point, but incomplete as a statement about this machine: the sibling main worktree (also at commit 9305cc8, untouched throughout) has substantial LOCAL, GITIGNORED, NEVER-COMMITTED raw per-run artifacts (results.jsonl, checkpoint_manifest.json, baseline_scores.json, etc.) for stage6/stage7b/stage8/stage9/stage11-S1 -- discovered only when the full CPU regression suite's own pre-existing tests (which assume this local raw data exists) failed in the isolated worktree but passed identically in the main worktree.
mid_task_correction.correction_made: The raw, gitignored, never-committed files were copied (plain local file copy, checksum-verified byte-identical, never a git operation, never touching any commit/branch) from the main worktree into this isolated worktree at identical relative paths. Phase 3's CI method was upgraded from a parametric approximation to a true nonparametric bootstrap wherever raw per-direction data is now available (stage8 3B). Phases 4 (transfer) and 5 (guided search) were recomputed using the real stage8 3B raw per-candidate results.jsonl and now return real PASS/FAIL verdicts (both FAIL) instead of NOT_MEASURABLE -- see transfer_results.json / guided_search_results.json for the full protocol and numbers.
mid_task_correction.what_remains_genuinely_unavailable: No raw per-candidate 7B or 32B data exists ANYWHERE (committed or local, in either worktree) -- confirmed by the same discovery process. Transfer and guided-search remain 3B-only. Cross-scale (7B-32B) remains NOT_MEASURABLE -- zero 32B result rows exist locally or in git.

No raw 7B or 32B per-candidate data exists anywhere, so this remains 3B-only.
answers_to_the_10_inventory_questions.8_can_anatomy_guided_search_be_simulated: Yes, at 3B -- a deterministic train/held-out fold simulation (by direction_index parity) was run from the same locally-restored raw data (see guided_search_results.json). Verdict: FAIL (only 2 of 6 capabilities show guided search beating fair random-region search in a majority of radii; threshold is 3).
answers_to_the_10_inventory_questions.9_which_planned_claims_are_already_measu: All of STABLE_ANATOMY, STRUCTURED_TRANSFER, and GUIDED_SEARCH_VALUE are measurable at 3B (all three: FAIL). The weaker claim 'coarse anatomy structures density/magnitude in a capability-dependent way' (Stage 8/9's own claim gates) is also measurable and already supported at 3B. Only CROSS_SCALE_CONSISTENCY (7B-32B) remains NOT_MEASURABLE.
answers_to_the_10_inventory_questions.10_which_claims_specifically_require_32B: None can be usefully evaluated at 32B yet -- STABLE_ANATOMY, STRUCTURED_TRANSFER, and GUIDED_SEARCH_VALUE all already fail at the 3B/7B scales that ARE measured, so a 32B confirmation of a not-yet-established claim is not the current bottleneck. If they had passed, the missing 32B cells would be the full 6-capability x 3-region x {small, transition} radius grid (64 directions/cell each) -- see cross_scale_results.json's exact_missing_S1_cells_required.
